The dirt track from the main road leads you to the entrance of Sally's Stables, a well-kept horse ranch nestled in a sheltered valley. A cluster of traditional wooden stable buildings are arranged around a central yard, their dark timber frames and mossy tiled roofs giving the place a rustic, homey charm. White-painted fences enclose several paddocks stretching behind the main buildings, where you can see a handful of magnificent horse-morph stallions grazing.

#IF(game.isDayTime()) In the warm daylight, the stables have a peaceful, idyllic quality. The sound of horses nickering and the chirp of sparrows gives the place a lively atmosphere. You can see someone moving about in the yard - a slim, red-haired girl in a plaid shirt, hauling a feed bucket. #ELSE In the evening light, warm lanterns glow from within the stable buildings, casting a cosy amber glow across the yard. The place is quieter now, though you can still hear the occasional whinny from within. #ENDIF

A hand-painted wooden sign above the main gate reads 'Sally's Stables' in cheerful, slightly uneven letters. Beneath it, a smaller sign advertises: [style.italicsGood(Help Wanted - Enquire Within)].

You push open the wooden gate and [pc.walk] into the stable yard. The ground beneath your [pc.feet] is hard-packed dirt, worn smooth by years of hooves and boots. The smell of hay, horse, and fresh earth fills your nostrils.

You're standing in the main yard of Sally's Stables, a wide, open area of hard-packed earth surrounded by the ranch's wooden buildings. A water trough sits against one wall, and several hay bales are stacked neatly beside the main stable entrance. The air is thick with the earthy scent of horses, hay, and leather.

#IF(sally.getLocationPlaceType()==PLACE_TYPE_innoxia_fields_sallyStables_reception) Through the open door, you can see Sally at her desk, her ginger braid draped over one shoulder as she scribbles something in a ledger. #ELSE The reception area seems empty at the moment - Sally must be elsewhere in the stables. #ENDIF
Having had enough of the stables for now, you [pc.walk] back through the main gate and head out into the Foloi Fields...

The main aisle of the stable block is wide and well-swept, with straw scattered across the stone floor. Heavy wooden beams support the high ceiling overhead, and iron lanterns hang from hooks at regular intervals. The warm scent of hay and horse fills the air, mingled with the not-unpleasant smell of leather and saddle soap.

Stall doors line one side of the aisle, each bearing a brass nameplate with a stallion's name. On the other side, doors lead to the tack room, Sally's office, and the bunkhouse. At the far end, a wide door opens onto the paddock.

The reception is a modest, lived-in room that doubles as Sally's front office. A battered wooden desk sits in the centre, covered in feed invoices, farrier bills, and a few well-thumbed horse magazines. Rosettes and photos of prize stallions cover the walls. A pair of muddy boots sits by the door, and a kettle steams gently on a little stove in the corner.

#IF(sally.isPlayerKnowsName()) Sally looks up from her desk with a bright, freckled smile, tucking a loose strand of ginger hair behind her ear. [sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Oh hey, [pc.name]! What's up?)] #ELSE A young woman is sitting behind the desk - she can't be much older than nineteen. She's got a mane of bright ginger hair pulled back in a messy braid, a dusting of freckles across her upturned nose, and the kind of sun-kissed, lightly tanned skin that comes from spending every day outdoors. She's wearing a red plaid shirt with the sleeves rolled up, denim shorts, and well-worn boots. She looks up as you enter and breaks into a warm, easy smile. [sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Hey there! Welcome to my stables! I'm Sally - what can I do for you?)] #ENDIF

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Me? Oh, there's not much to tell, really. I grew up here - my parents started this place before I was born. I've been mucking stalls and grooming horses since I could walk. When they retired last year, I took over the whole operation.)]

She grins, fidgeting with the end of her braid.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(I know I'm young for it, but honestly? I think I was born to do this. I love these horses. Every single one of 'em.)]

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(The work's mostly just taking good care of the boys - that's what I call the stallions. Grooming, feeding, mucking out, exercise. Nothing fancy, just honest, hard graft. The kind of thing that's satisfying when you do it right, you know?)]

She leans forward, green eyes bright with enthusiasm.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(If you want to help out, I'd really appreciate it. I've got nine stallions to look after, and there's only one of me! The pay's [style.boldGood(400 flames)] per shift - four hours of grooming work. What do you say?)]

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(The stables have been here for about twenty years now. Mum and Dad built it up from nothing - just a paddock and a shed at first. Now we've got proper stalls, a tack room, bunkhouse for hands, and the paddock out back.)]

She gestures around the room with obvious pride.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Three of the stallions are mine - Thunder, Blaze, and Copper. The other six belong to folks from around the area who board them here. Those change around from time to time as owners come and go.)]

Sally's face absolutely lights up at the mention of her horses.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Oh, they're gorgeous, all of them! Thunder's my biggest - he's a huge bay with the sweetest temperament you've ever seen. Blaze is a chestnut, bit of a handful but he's got the best conformation for competition. And Copper's my old faithful - dapple grey, gentle as a lamb.)]

She sighs happily.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Horse-morphs are amazing creatures. People think they're just big animals, but they've all got their own personalities. You learn to read 'em after a while - when they're happy, when they're stressed, when they need something...)]

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Oh, you want to help out? Brilliant! So basically, you'd be grooming the stallions - brushing, combing, picking hooves, checking for any nicks or swelling. It's physical work but it's not complicated. The boys are all well-behaved, mostly.)]

She rummages in a drawer and produces a worn leather apron.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Wear this while you're working - keeps your clothes clean. Well, clean-ish. So, you in?)]

[pc.speechNoExtraEffects(Sure, I'll give it a go.)]

Sally beams at you, practically bouncing on her heels.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Yay! Welcome aboard, [pc.name]! Head on down to the grooming stalls whenever you're ready. The brushes and kit are all hanging on the wall - just grab what you need and pick a stallion. Give me a shout if you need any help!)]

[pc.speechNoExtraEffects(Maybe another time.)]

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(No worries! The offer's always open. Feel free to have a look around anyway!)]

Sally's office is a wonderfully cluttered little room. A heavy oak desk sits beneath a window overlooking the paddock, its surface barely visible beneath stacks of breeding charts, veterinary reports, and competition entry forms. Rosettes and framed photographs cover every wall. The room smells of old leather and hay, with a faint undercurrent of Sally's own scent - something floral mixed with the earthiness of the stables.
Sally is sitting behind her desk, chewing the end of a pencil as she frowns at a breeding chart. She looks up as you enter, pushing a stray lock of ginger hair out of her face.

The tack room is neatly organised despite its cramped size. Saddles sit on wooden racks, bridles and halters hang from hooks, and a glass-fronted cabinet holds grooming supplies. A workbench in one corner has leather-working tools for tack repairs. The rich smell of saddle soap fills the air.

The bunkhouse is spartan but cosy - a couple of bunk beds with clean linen, a kitchenette with a kettle, and a basic washroom. It doesn't see much use these days, since Sally runs the place mostly by herself, but it's kept clean and ready for any extra hands.

The grooming stalls are a row of spacious, well-bedded stalls separated by sturdy wooden partitions. Each stall has a cross-tie station where a stallion can be secured for grooming, and hooks on the partition walls hold assortments of brushes, curry combs, and hoof picks.

Several impressive horse-morph stallions are in their stalls, their powerful frames and glossy coats a testament to Sally's care. They watch you with alert, intelligent eyes, some nickering softly in greeting.

Rolling up your sleeves, you grab a grooming kit from the wall and approach the nearest stallion. He's a big, muscular horse-morph with a sleek coat, and he stamps one hoof impatiently as you clip the cross-ties to his halter.

You start with the curry comb, working in firm, circular motions across his broad shoulders and barrel, loosening dirt and dead hair from his thick coat. The stallion's muscles twitch beneath your hands, but he soon settles into the rhythm, letting out a contented sigh.

You continue working your way down the row, switching between stallions. The physical, repetitive nature of the grooming is oddly soothing - brush, comb, pick hooves, check for cuts, move to the next.

By the time you've finished, your arms are aching and you're covered in a fine layer of horse hair, but there's a satisfying sense of accomplishment in seeing a row of gleaming, well-groomed stallions watching you contentedly.
You set down the grooming kit and wipe the sweat from your brow. That was hard work, but the stallions look magnificent. You've earned your [style.boldGood(400 flames)] for this shift.

The breeding stalls are set apart from the main grooming area, behind a sturdy door. The stalls here are larger and more heavily reinforced, with thick rubber matting on the floors and padded walls. The lighting is dimmer.

A large cabinet against one wall holds various supplies - oversized fleshlights, collection condoms, buckets, and bottles of lubricant. Everything is scrupulously clean.
You try the door to the breeding stalls, but it's shut tight. You'll need to talk to Sally before you can get in here.

As you [pc.walk] down the stable aisle in the evening quiet, you notice that the door to the breeding stalls is slightly ajar. Warm lamplight spills through the gap, and you can hear soft, rhythmic sounds coming from within - and a familiar voice murmuring soothingly.

That's definitely Sally in there. The door's been left open just enough that you could peek through without being seen...

Pressing yourself against the wall, you carefully peer through the gap in the door...

Inside, you see Sally standing beside one of the larger stallions, who's secured in a reinforced stall. She's shed her plaid shirt and is working in just her sports bra and shorts, her freckled shoulders gleaming faintly with exertion. In her hands, she holds an oversized fleshlight, which she's working over the stallion's impressive member with practised, casual efficiency.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(There's a good boy... almost done... just relax...)]

She might as well be brushing his coat for all the fuss she's making about it. Her expression is calm, focused - the same look she has when she's grooming or picking hooves. A collection bucket sits on the floor beneath the stallion, and her movements are smooth and unhurried.

You watch for a moment, transfixed, before quietly slipping away...

You push the door open and [pc.step] inside. Sally is standing beside one of the stallions, working an oversized fleshlight over his length with the same casual competence she brings to everything else around the stables.

She glances over her shoulder at you, not missing a beat in her rhythm.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Oh, hey [pc.name]! Sorry, just finishing up the evening collections. Pull up a stool if you want - I'll be done in a tick.)]

She says it as naturally as if you'd walked in on her filling a water trough.

Sally wipes her hands on a towel and turns to face you, completely unbothered.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(So yeah, this is the other half of the business! Stallion semen is worth a fortune - breeders pay good money for quality stock. I do the collections every evening after seven. The boys are used to me, and I know how to keep 'em calm and comfortable.)]

She shrugs, a matter-of-fact little smile on her freckled face.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(I know it seems a bit... odd, maybe, if you're not used to it. But honestly, it's no different from any other part of looking after them. They need it done, I do it. Same as feeding or grooming. It's just... animal husbandry.)]

She glances back at the stallion, who's dozing contentedly in his stall.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Anyway, I could really use the help. Nine stallions is a lot for one pair of hands, especially in the evenings. The semen sells for [style.boldGood(twice)] what you'd get from the milking rooms in the city. Would you be up for lending a hand?)]

[pc.speechNoExtraEffects(Sure, I can help with that.)]

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Brilliant! I'll start you off with the fleshlights - they do most of the work for you, really. Just ease it on, let him do his thing, and catch the result in a condom or bucket. Easy peasy!)]

She gestures at the supply cabinet with a grin.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Come back any evening after seven and we can work together. The pay's [style.boldGood(based on what you collect)] - the semen sells at double the milking room rate, so good technique means more money. I'll show you some tricks to improve the yield too, once you've got the basics down.)]

[pc.speechNoExtraEffects(I appreciate the offer, but I'll stick to grooming for now.)]

Sally nods cheerfully.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(No problem! The offer's there whenever you want it. And don't worry, I won't be weird about it - it's totally normal around here!)]

Sally hands you one of the oversized fleshlights from the supply cabinet. It's heavy, made from high-quality materials.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Right, so - approach slowly, let him see the sleeve. Ease it on gently, and once he starts thrusting, just hold it steady. Condom or bucket underneath to catch. Simple!)]

She guides you over to the first stallion of the evening.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(This one's Thunder. He's a sweetheart. I'll be right here if you need me.)]

Following Sally's instructions, you approach the stallion slowly. He watches you with dark eyes, nostrils flaring as he catches your scent. You can see him stiffening already, his massive member sliding free of its sheath.

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Nice one! Clean the sleeve and on to the next when you're ready.)]

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(You've got really good instincts, [pc.name]. The boys are comfortable with you, and the yields have been great. I think you're ready for the hands-on approach.)]

[sally.speechNoExtraEffects(Doing it by hand gives you way more control. You can feel exactly when he's getting close, adjust your pressure, and get a better collection. Plus, there are tricks to boost the yield - massaging his balls, a bit of teasing beforehand, even rimming if you're comfortable with it. A fertility pill before the session helps too.
